hints.title: String Length Inspection
hints.text: The width of any single number is simply the length of its string representation, accounting for negative signs.

hints.title: Column-by-Column Aggregation
hints.text: For each column index c from 0 to n - 1, iterate over all row indices r from 0 to m - 1.

hints.title: Maximal Width Record
hints.text: Find the maximum string length across all rows in that column and append it to the answer.

hints.title: Matrix Column Width Implementation

complexity.notes: Inspects each grid cell and its digit count once.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space beyond the output array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Traverses by column and takes maximum string length.
